cases.name: ds_load_wait
cases.title: LDS load result read without s_wait_dscnt

fixed.note: s_wait_dscnt 0x0 between the load and its reader.

hazard.note: v_add_nc_u32 reads the ds_load_b32 destination with the load outstanding.

cases.name: global_load_wait
cases.title: global load result read without s_wait_loadcnt

fixed.note: s_wait_loadcnt 0x0 between the load and its reader.

hazard.note: v_add_nc_u32 reads the global_load_b32 destination with the load outstanding.

cases.basis: LLVM AMDGPUUsage.md, Memory Model GFX12: s_wait_dscnt 0x0 synchronises LDS with vector memory between waves; LLVM (SIMemoryLegalizer.cpp SIGfx12CacheControl::insertWait) emits it before a workgroup barrier only for a cross-address-space release fence, not for LDS-only synchronisation like this probe: the probe measures whether the hardware needs it here
cases.name: lds_store_barrier
cases.title: LDS store still outstanding at the workgroup barrier

hazard.note: ds_store_b32, then s_barrier_signal/s_barrier_wait with no s_wait_dscnt; then each thread reads the word another wave stored.

cases.name: wmma_d_to_a
cases.title: WMMA result D used as A of the next WMMA with no VALU in between

fixed.note: v_nop between the two WMMAs (what fixWMMAHazards inserts).

hazard.note: the second v_wmma reads v[72:75] (D of the first) as A immediately.

cases.basis: RDNA4 ISA 7.2.8; LLVM GCNHazardRecognizer::fixVcmpxPermlaneHazards (FeatureVcmpxPermlaneHazard, in FeatureISAVersion12; inserts V_MOV_B32 src0, src0 because "V_NOP will be discarded by SQ")
cases.name: cmpx_permlane
cases.title: v_permlane16 right after a v_cmpx that writes EXEC

fixed.note: v_mov_b32 src0, src0 in between (what fixVcmpxPermlaneHazards inserts).

hazard.note: v_cmpx_gt_u32 (lanes 0-15 stay active), then v_permlane16_b32 immediately. EXEC is restored inside the asm and declared clobbered (clang warns -Winline-asm that exec is reserved; harmless here).

cases.basis: LLVM AMDGPUWaitSGPRHazards.cpp (GFX12 VALU SGPR read hazard); s_wait_alu fields: RDNA4 ISA S_WAITCNT_DEPCTR
cases.name: alu_wait_carry
cases.title: VALU reads an SGPR (carry) a VALU wrote, with no s_wait_alu depctr_va_sdst(0)

fixed.note: s_wait_alu 0xf1ff (depctr_va_sdst(0)) before the reader, as the pass inserts.

hazard.note: v_add_co_u32 writes the carry SGPR, v_add_co_ci_u32 reads it next (pair tracked by an earlier VALU read).

cases.basis: LLVM AMDGPUWaitSGPRHazards.cpp numbers every ttmp as SGPR 0 (SIRegisterInfo.td HW encoding), so it emits no wait here; radisa reports ALU_WAIT_TTMP (warning). Not documented by AMD
cases.name: alu_wait_ttmp
cases.title: the MISSING_ALU_WAIT shape with a scalar read of ttmp0 in between (radisa/sgpr.py)

hazard.note: v_mov reads s0 (pair 0 tracked), v_add_co_u32 writes the carry, s_cmp_eq_u32 reads ttmp0, v_add_co_ci_u32 reads the carry with no s_wait_alu (LLVM emits none here).

cases.basis: RDNA4 ISA 5.7.1 (LOADcnt returns in order); relaxation as in LLVM SIInsertWaitcnts (D16 halves)
cases.name: d16_other_half
cases.title: 16-bit store of the low half while a D16 load is outstanding

fixed.note: lo-half load first: s_wait_loadcnt 0x1 retires it, the store runs while the hi-half load is still outstanding (accepted by radisa, emitted by LLVM). A mismatch here is evidence against that relaxation, not only a harness bug.

hazard.note: hi-half load, then lo-half load, s_wait_loadcnt 0x1 retires only the hi load; global_store_b16 reads the lo half with its load outstanding.

note: UNTESTED ON HARDWARE. A mismatch on a hazard variant is evidence for the rule; zero mismatches do not show the rule is unnecessary. A mismatch on a fixed variant is a harness bug.
